Dusk neon-glow — trans-element ride-outlines blazing as the sky deepens, warm multicolor spill pooling across the brick midway, amber and pink touching the canopy peaks.
Summer-night full ride-lights — deep navy ambient with trans-red, trans-blue, and trans-yellow ride-blazing, colored pools reflected on brick paths, minifig crowds lit from all sides.
Golden-hour park — low warm side-light raking from camera-left, gilding canopy-tops and ride-struts, long soft plastic shadows stretching down the midway in amber.
Fireworks-lit sky — dark overhead broken by trans-element burst-pieces, brief multicolor flash raking downward onto upturned minifig faces and ride-tops in scattered pink and gold.
Bright midday — strong high-overhead key bleaching the candy-colored rides into saturated contrast, short crisp plastic shadows pooling directly beneath each stall and car.
Haunted-house spooky glow — trans-green and trans-purple spilling outward from mansion-window bricks, eerie upward cast on surrounding minifig faces, deep shadow swallowing the midway beyond.
Blue-hour chase-lights — deep cobalt ambient with sequenced trans-element bulb-strings suggesting motion on every ride, warm vendor-stall glow pooling low below the lattice framework.
Sunset-silhouette skyline — magenta and gold backlight rimming the ride-skyline in sharp silhouette, ride-lights just winking on, foreground midway falling into warm purple shadow.
Warm string-light pools — arching clip-rod strings casting overlapping warm amber ovals on the brick path and stall roofs, deep cozy shadow filling the gaps between pools.
Hard noon ride-shadows — strong overhead source throwing crisp dark lattice-shadows of coaster struts and ferris spokes across the ground-plate in graphic, high-contrast geometry.
Carnival-dusk crosslight — two low opposing sources, one amber and one trans-blue, crossing the midway and throwing split-tone shadows across brick stall facades and ride-cars.
Rainy-night reflections — dark overhead ambient with trans-element ride-lights doubled in a wet-look baseplate surface, streaked color pooling in rivulet-shapes across the brick ground.
Cotton-candy pink hour — soft diffuse pink side-light from camera-right bathing every ride and minifig in rose, gentle shadows barely present, a dreamy sugary-fair warmth.
Coaster-launch flash — a sharp directional trans-yellow burst from low front-left suggesting the launch-gate light, hard shadow flung long behind the coaster car and riders.
Midway-game neon ring — warm trans-orange spill from a ring-toss stall overhead, tight pool on the counter and prize-shelf bricks, the surrounding midway falling quickly to dusk.
Spinning-ride centrifugal glow — trans-element car-lights radiating outward from ride-center in a spoke-pattern of red, blue, and yellow, dimming to shadow at the midway edges.
Carnival-twilight amber — a low front-side warm source catching every stud-top and ride-strut in amber, while the sky behind deepens to indigo and the first trans-lights glow.
Rainy-night reflection — cool diffuse overhead with trans-blue and trans-yellow ride-light color bleeding across wet-look dark grey plates, the slick-ground spectacle of an after-rain fair.
Early-morning soft open — pale neutral side-light barely warming the empty midway, long gentle shadows, the hushed pre-crowd atmosphere before the rides have stirred.
Overcast flat-fair — soft even diffuse source removing harsh shadow, every color reading clean and equal, the low-contrast workhorse that lets brick texture carry the scene.
Spinning-ride strobe — tight hard side-source in trans-white imitating a fast strobe burst, frozen mid-spin arm casting a single sharp shadow across the brick platform below.
Cotton-candy pink dusk — pink-tinted low backlight warming the ride-tops and minifig hair, soft warm fill from the front, the pastel-sweet end-of-afternoon fairground palette.
Ghost-train entrance flood — trans-orange footlight low from below the archway, hard upward shadows climbing the dark-stone brick facade, the theatrical horror-entrance reveal.
Ferris-wheel backlight ring — a diffuse warm ring-source behind the ferris structure, separating each spoke from the dark sky and haloing the gondola brickwork in warm gold.
Tilt-a-whirl colored sweep — three small colored gels in trans-red, trans-blue, trans-yellow sweeping from low angles, overlapping pools of hue on the circular ground-plate beneath.
Midsummer fair noon — blazing high-key source with short shadows, bright awning stripes reading saturated, heat-haze suggestion in a slightly warm white fill bouncing off pale plates.
Autumn-fair late-light — low warm-orange raking source from one side, catching bare tree-branch bricks and turning the midway gold, long cold shadows reaching left across grey plates.
Rollercoaster launch-flash — single hard trans-white burst from the launch-track end, bleaching the front car, leaving the remaining coaster cars in sharp receding shadow behind it.
Midway-night vendor warmth — overhead diffuse dark ambient with isolated warm downlights over each stall awning, leaving the walkways between in cool deep shadow and color contrast.
Closing-time half-dark — most ride-lights off, one warm lamp-post source casting a single warm circle on the emptying brick midway, long desolate shadow in every direction.
Sparkler hand-held fill — small tight warm trans-yellow point-source at minifig height, casting rapid upward shadow on the surrounding stall faces, a brief intimate festive accent.
Summer-night ride-lights — deep navy ambient wash from above, every ride blazing trans-red and trans-blue, colored pools reflected on the brick paths below the minifig crowds.
Carnival dusk cross-light — warm amber key from the right meeting a soft trans-pink fill from the left, ride silhouettes edged in color, long overlapping shadows crossing the brick midway.
Overcast diffuse day — a broad soft overhead source flattening shadows, saturated ride colors reading cleanly against pale grey, gentle even light across every brick surface and minifig face.
Twilight ride-reflection — deep blue-purple ambient above, trans-element ride lights casting warm colored streaks across a wet-look brick plaza tile, the shimmer of a post-rain evening fair.
Early-morning opening — low warm side-light from the left, long pale-gold shadows, the empty brick midway glowing softly before the crowds arrive, a quiet hopeful fairground dawn.
Trans-yellow carousel glow — warm trans-yellow light radiating outward from the carousel center in diminishing rings onto the surrounding brick path, minifig faces lit in honey-gold from the side.
Storm-lit fair — a cold blue-grey ambient overhead with a single dramatic warm key punching through from the right, ride-tops bright, deep dramatic shadow falling hard across the brick ground.
Neon-sign anchor — a dense trans-red and trans-orange source at mid-height on the left, washing the adjacent stall-fronts and brick path in warm ruddy color, the entrance-sign landmark glow.
Deep-night coaster silhouette — near-black ambient with only the trans-element coaster-outline lights visible, the brick ground in darkness except where colored pools fall from the ride-edge bulbs.
Autumn-fair afternoon — a low warm amber key raking from the right, long cool blue-grey shadows trailing left, golden light catching the ride-tops and the tops of minifig hats.
Funhouse mirror corner — trans-yellow and trans-orange from a low front source, bouncing back in implied reflections onto the brick wall tiles, the garish close-up glow of the funhouse facade.

Midway at magic hour — a split warm-above and cool-below ambient, trans-element stall lights adding saturated accent color in rings and pools on the brick path, the transitional layered fairground light.

Ride-launch silhouette — strong warm back-key behind the launch tower, throwing it into silhouette, the front faces of minifigs in deep cool shade, only the trans-element launch-lights catching the foreground bricks.

Full-dark sparkler light — a single small warm trans-yellow point source held low, scattering warm directional light across the brick ground tiles and minifig hands, deep shadow filling the background.
Cotton-candy-pink dusk — a low soft trans-pink source from the right blending into violet shadow on the left, ride-tops edged in warm pink, the brick midway blushing across its full width.
Closing-time amber — a lone warm amber overhead key left of center, all other sources dimming, long soft shadows on the brick path, the tired golden glow of the fair winding down.
